scope.measured_depth_role: Both spatial folds are permitted adaptation observations, never final test data

fusion_policy.device: same local CUDA device for all four states
fusion_policy.historical_confidence_limit: No historical per-partner confidence bytes were archived; validate deterministic reconstruction against sealed fused depth/confidence

scope.calibration_preparation: Construct both support states once from B0 only, preserving its gauges, sensor normalizers, robust factors and ridge for B0/B1/F0/F1; do not initialize separately from FP32 outputs
scope.graph_zero_policy: Use matches=[] and graph_weight=0; prove sensor-only A,b,ridge/query equivalence in synthetic tests instead of loading unused correspondence caches via prepare_training

comparisons.fold_aggregation: None; retain both folds and identify disagreement

resources.rule: Prepare locally, stop on failure/cap; no retry with changed scientific settings

Freeze executable source/runtime/input/call inventory, numerical tolerances and exact commands; commit before D1 access
Construct one pristine unwrapped frozen model and reproduce five cached encoder features exactly as historical P3 did

Reset Torch seed42, install exact144 LoRA modules, verify initial adapter digest, freeze all factors again, load only saved final P3 factors, verify its digest, and collect20 pairs on the same features; original state must remain unchanged

finite_response.definitions: s_k=solve(A_k^T A_k+lambda I,A_k^T b+lambda*1), e_k=Q_k s_k-d
finite_response.interpretation: Exact finite response along observed output change; t is a fixed-s0 counterfactual, not a forward-identical detached-gradient arm
finite_response.zero_policy: Zero direct norm or either zero cosine norm yields undefined ratio/cosine; never add epsilon or drop a fold to manufacture a value
finite_response.attenuation_rule: Negative compensation cosine alone is insufficient: surviving norm must also be below direct norm beyond the frozen numerical tolerance; otherwise report amplification or unresolved change

derivative.state: final P3 training-path fused depth z_B1
derivative.tolerances: Must be fixed from synthetic float64 fixtures in the executable registration before D1 data access

permitted: Only images member from selected RGB archive
Only Heads/earlier adaptation coordinates/depths and both original spatial-fold assignments
Only the original supplied camera calibration needed by the frozen training preparation
Selected sealed P3 teacher and final adapter artifacts
Selected P0/P3 raw FP32 first-camera pointmaps
forbidden: Additional scenes or final P2/P4/P5 adapters
input_boundary.preserve_supplied_intrinsic: Use the historical intrinsic() including1.12 focal multiplier and pixel-center resize; do not correct supplied calibration in this diagnostic

interpretation_rules: No resolved BF16 query-residual benefit in both folds: useful training change lost downstream is not established
Benefit in both BF16 folds disappearing or reversing in FP32 under same fusion: defined inference-path mismatch is supported
Opposing measured calibration response attenuates the change: compensation in this output-space direction is supported; harmfulness and parameter-space generality are not
Benefit survives both inference paths: these stages do not explain failed held-source accuracy; overfitting/matching/native effects remain unresolved
Fold disagreement is mixed/inconclusive, never select the favorable fold
No diagnostic outcome alone releases a redesign, M3 or rental; choose at most one evidence-supported scientific redesign afterward
interpretation_numeric_floor: Executable registration must fix loss/ratio resolution floors from synthetic float64 arithmetic before D1 access; no post-result threshold tuning or statistical-significance claim
preparation_clarification: Source review confirmed the historical pristine-teacher-before-LoRA order and common CUDA FP32 fusion. These clarifications precede all D1 production-array access and do not change the40-call/no-update scope.
